core_move_guess: Test statements by considering edge cases and counterexamples.
mini_steps: Statement I: x < n for all x, n. Consider large x, e.g., x=10, n=1. False.
Statement II: For all x, there exists n such that x < n. True, n can be x+1.
Statement III: There exists x such that for all n, x < n. False, no such x exists.
wrong_move: Assuming a statement is true without rigorous proof or failing to consider extreme values as potential counterexamples.
